{{nihongo|'''Juniso Kumano Shrine'''|熊野神社|lead=yes}} is a [[Kumano shrine]] in {{ill|Nishi-Shinjuku|en|Nishi-Shinjuku|qid=Q430349|lt=Nishi-Shinjuku}} (west {{ill|Shinjuku|en|Shinjuku|qid=Q179645|lt=Shinjuku}}), {{ill|Tokyo|en|Tokyo|qid=Q1490|lt=Tokyo}}, Japan, on the western side of {{ill|Shinjuku Central Park|en|Shinjuku Central Park|qid=Q5364883|lt=Shinjuku Central Park}}.
